answer: Make identity expensive: every agent must lock a stake that works like pigment, a visible, costly mark on each account. New agents start with tiny transaction limits that grow only through verified honest work, so a plume of thousands of fake accounts stays stuck at low-value trades. Random peer audits slash the stake of any caught sybil and burn its opal reputation score, so creating 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 stakes while an honest agent pays once.
